instruction:
`/tmp_workspace/paper.tex` compiles successfully, but the rendered PDF has two problems that **can only be detected by visual inspection**:

1. **Figure 1 visually overflows the right margin** — the included image width is set incorrectly.
2. **Figure 1 ends up on the wrong page** — the Discussion section says "Figure 1 shows ...", but the `Figure 1:` caption is actually rendered on an earlier page (because the figure float [t] places too eagerly and pushes the body text down).

Task: Modify `/tmp_workspace/paper.tex` (this file only) so that (a) the figure no longer overflows the right margin; (b) the figure lands on the **same page** as the Discussion sentence "Figure 1 shows ...".

Deliverables (write to `/tmp_workspace/results/`):

- `paper.pdf` — the PDF re-compiled after the fix.
- `proof.png` — a proof screenshot showing the figure and the "Figure 1 shows ..." paragraph on the same page, with the figure no longer overflowing the right margin.
- `report.md`, which **must** contain:
   - `width_token: <whatever you ended up writing for width=>`
   - `same_page: yes`
   - `tool_used: <name>`
   - A description of at least 30 characters explaining the visual difference between the PDF before and after the fix.

parameters.warmup:
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results || true
which pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1 || apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-latex-extra || true
which pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1 || apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils || true
bash /tmp_workspace/make_plot.sh || true
chown -R user:user /tmp_workspace || true
rm -f /home/user/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/*.lock 2>/dev/null || true
openclaw config unset agents.defaults.imageModel >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
openclaw config set agents.defaults.sandbox.imageModel.primary "" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
